long_biography.plain_text:
Motorsport gave Buzzetta the opportunity that launched his commercial career. While serving with the US Army in Germany, he began racing sports cars and later joined Porsche's factory team. Class victories at Daytona and Sebring culminated in an overall win at the 1967 Nürburgring 1000 Kilometres.

Back on Long Island, he left his family's restaurant and co-founded Competition Engineering with racing mechanic Oscar Rubio, using a loan from his father. Repair work led to used-car sales and then Porsche, BMW, Datsun and Mercedes-Benz franchises. The enterprise grew into Competition Auto Group, employing hundreds across multiple dealerships and remaining central to Buzzetta's working life until his death in 2023.
